results.title: Agent development, evidence and bounded reviews
results.summary: Review FAILED after 3 cycle(s) with 2 blocking finding(s). Headless runs do not commit at the cycle cap; changes left unstaged.
findings: high/spec-deviation app/Actions/Publishing/StartEditorialActivity.php:243 — eligibleEvidenceSources freezes every source on the attempt, so stale sources from old research/angle cycles remain eligible for Plan/Draft/review prompts and citation validation even though completedResearchSnapshots filters research to the current approval; the spec requires relevant frozen source passages and validation against that eligible set, not every DB ID → Filter sources to owner-supplied/consented material plus evidence attached to current-approval research activities, and add a regression that angle A evidence is absent after angle B research

high/spec-deviation app/Actions/Publishing/StartEditorialActivity.php:319 — Partially persists from cycle 2: selected voice_sample_ids can still produce no frozen excerpts because boundedVoiceSamples silently drops samples with null excerpts, so automatic review prompts can omit the selected voice material → Load archived excerpts or require non-empty excerpts before persisting selected IDs/starting reviews, and assert UI-selected review activity inputs have non-null voice_context.samples excerpts
